routing_reason: Existing Stripe Billing source update: full new raw + matched prior raw + current source; preserve version, UI variant, client/server, state and dated evidence boundaries; no semantic assumptions from collection diff alone.
findings: Both May and November captures of https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/trials/free-trials call `trial_end` free trial periods a legacy path and recommend Trial Offers for new integrations (old 4-14; new 5-15). November adds a comparison link at new 13; that is navigation, not a newly deprecated API. The current source 11-13 accurately flags legacy, but `wiki/concepts/stripe-subscriptions.md` 157-165 lists the Checkout trial path without a legacy qualification and `wiki/concepts/stripe-subscriptions-trial-offers.md` 8-14 has separate preview/flexible-mode limits. Keep the paths distinct rather than claim Trial Offers universally replace `trial_end`.

The core legacy trial rules remain: Accounts v2 customer-configured `Account` uses `customer_account`, Customers v1 uses `customer` (new 17-43); `trial_end` is a timestamp or `trial_period_days` an integer with 730-day maximum (new 45). A trial can start without a payment method and creates a zero-amount invoice; when it ends, if not paused, Stripe creates an invoice and `invoice.created`, then attempts charge approximately an hour later (new 47-49). This does not itself prove charge success or active status.

The three missing-payment-method end behaviors remain distinct: cancel terminates and requires a new subscription for later paid service; pause stops invoice creation and can remain indefinitely until resume; `create_invoice` invoices and moves to `past_due` if no payment method at finalization (new 87-92; old 106-111). A true `paused` subscription differs from `pause_collection`, which continues invoicing and billing periods (new 90,313-317). Current source 24-26 is too terse to capture the reactivation boundary.

November adds explicit Dashboard UI visibility conditions for both cancel and pause: the option is hidden if a payment method was provided or email-invoice-to-customer was chosen (new 100-109,176-185). The May pause Dashboard steps paradoxically said to click Cancel subscription while listening for paused (old 244-252); November corrects the UI instruction to select Pause (new 178-183). This is a real captured UI correction, not proof that a payment method can never be configured through other paths.

For Checkout no-payment-method trials, both captures show `subscription_data.trial_settings.end_behavior.missing_payment_method` as cancel/pause plus `payment_method_collection=if_required`; this makes collection optional in that Checkout Session, not all subscription flows (new 147-170,223-246; old 201-238,326-363). API examples additionally set `payment_settings.save_default_payment_method=on_subscription`, but examples do not prove that setting is required to configure missing-method behavior (new 115-145,191-221).

A paused subscription can be resumed without first supplying a method, but its resumption invoice must be paid before reactivation; the 23-hour auto-void statement applies when the associated PaymentIntent has no method attached and is unconfirmed (new 295-303; old 410-418). Current source 25 implies adding a PM alone resumes, and source 32 states an unqualified 23-hour payment window and `billing_cycle_anchor: now` default. Correct to the action/payment and conditional void described in the capture; the document does not explicitly establish that anchor default.

Version and modality matter: `trial_start` reflects the most recent trial only for flexible billing as of API 2025-04-30; for most other repeat trials it stays at the first trial (new 69-73). The Accounts v2 availability/preview statement is qualified at new 37-43. Root index 7 routes through Stripe index 626/792 to concept `wiki/concepts/stripe-subscriptions.md` 157-165,229 and this source. No repository file was edited.
substantive_changes: New comparison navigation for legacy trial periods versus Trial Offers and a new Accounts v2 preview enablement instruction (new 13,37-43 versus old 12,52-58); neither changes observed trial runtime.
Dashboard no-PM trial controls now have explicit visibility conditions; the pause instructions correct May's contradictory Cancel selection (new 100-109,176-185 versus old 121-127,244-252).

Dashboard resume UI now distinguishes reset anchor to now and optional prorated billing controls (new 285-293 versus old 402-409); API resume and paid-invoice gate remain materially the same (new 295-303 versus old 410-418).

Most Node examples were replaced with equivalent curl requests; this is presentation/sample language, not evidence that Node SDK usage was withdrawn (new 19-35,117-145,158-168,193-244,331-349 versus old 18-50,135-199,212-236,260-361,446-480).
conflicts: Current source 25 says paused subscriptions resume when a PM is added. New 301 and old 416 distinguish resume from PM attachment and require the resumption invoice to be paid before reactivation; new 307/311 describe portal and hosted-invoice actions. Narrow source and concept `wiki/concepts/stripe-subscriptions.md` 163's 'resumes on PM add' wording.

Current source 32 calls the 23-hour period an unqualified invoice-payment window and says `billing_cycle_anchor: now` is the default. New 301 only says auto-void after 23 hours if associated PaymentIntent lacks an attached method and is unconfirmed; new 297 says anchor can optionally change, without naming a default. Retain the explicit condition and leave default unresolved from this page.

Old pause Dashboard row 251 selected Cancel subscription but old 252 expected `customer.subscription.paused`; new 182-183 explicitly selects Pause and observes paused. Avoid reproducing the old UI mismatch as current instructions.

Current concept `wiki/concepts/stripe-subscriptions.md` 159-165 presents legacy Checkout trials without legacy/Trial Offers scope, while both captures label this path legacy (old 8-12; new 9-13). Add a concise dated qualification; trial-offers concept 8-14 describes a separate preview path with its own constraints.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Keep the May legacy designation, Trial Offers recommendation, 730-day cap, zero-amount first invoice, usage-meter behavior, three missing-PM outcomes and conditional resume-invoice payment rule (old 8-12,60-64,78-111,410-430); November largely retains them (new 9-13,45-49,59-92,295-315).

Keep May Node examples as dated implementation examples, while November uses curl. Omission does not deprecate the Node SDK or prove example timestamps form a valid current request; the anchor examples contain fixed historical timestamps (old 444-480; new 329-349).

Keep the old pause Dashboard instruction only as dated, internally inconsistent UI evidence (old 244-252); use November's Pause selection and `customer.subscription.paused` event for the newer captured UI (new 176-185).
unresolved_questions: The new Accounts v2 preview instruction names a Dashboard feature and version condition (new 37-43); no account-specific preview access or current eligibility was tested.
This guide does not state the default `billing_cycle_anchor` used on resume, despite current source 32's claim. Confirm against the dedicated resume API if that default is needed.
No live invoice, paid resumption, trial offer eligibility, or actual future charge result was observed. The fixed timestamp examples cannot establish a valid current transaction.
